title: STLTH Nexa Closed Pod Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
With its sleek and compact design, the STLTH Nexa fits comfortably in the palm of your hand, making it easy to carry and it’s perfectly compatible with our 2ml pods for convenient use. Its ergonomic and discreet design makes it a coveted choice for on-the-go usage.
The STLTH Nexa Device boasts an upgraded 650 mAh battery, ensuring extended vaping sessions without the constant need for recharging. When it’s time to recharge, the USB-Type-C port gets you back in action quickly
The LED screen on top provides clear digital battery indication, so you’re always aware of your device’s power levels. For a personalized experience, the airflow adjustment control located on the underside allows you to fine-tune your draw.
The STLTH Nexa is compatible with STLTH Original Pods, STLTH X Pods, STLTH Monster Pods, and STLTH Snap Pods. It is NOT compatible with STLTH Pro or Pro X Pods.

Battery:
